# Brain Load Instructions
# Auto-generated by scripts/build_brain_snapshot.py — do NOT edit by hand
#
# This file is regenerated every time /load-brain runs or build_brain_snapshot.py
# is executed. The values below are computed from the actual line count of
# .claude/brain_snapshot.md after it is built.
#
# Until build_brain_snapshot.py is implemented (see SETUP.md), this file is a
# placeholder showing the mechanism. Once the script runs, it overwrites this
# file with exact Read parameters for your snapshot.

## Mechanism

The snapshot file (.claude/brain_snapshot.md) is read in chunks of 650 lines per
Read call (~8,125 tokens, safely under the 10,000-token Read tool limit).
Reads are grouped into batches of up to 20 parallel calls each.

### Read tool limit
- 650 lines per call = ~8,125 tokens. SAFE.
- 1,000 lines per call = ~12,500 tokens. FAILS.
- Never exceed limit=650.

### Batch discipline
- Fire all calls in a batch in parallel.
- Wait for the batch to complete before starting the next batch.
- Never combine or skip batches.

## Example (illustrative — real values generated by the script)

After you implement and run build_brain_snapshot.py, this file will look like:

    # Brain Load Instructions
    # Auto-generated by build_brain_snapshot.py — do NOT edit
    # Snapshot: 40,000 lines, 62 reads, 4 batches
    # Read tool limit: 10,000 tokens per call. 650 lines = ~8,125 tokens. Safe.

    ## Batch 1 of 4 (fire all 20 in parallel)

    Read(file_path="/path/to/.claude/brain_snapshot.md", offset=0, limit=650)
    Read(file_path="/path/to/.claude/brain_snapshot.md", offset=650, limit=650)
    ...

    ## Batch 2 of 4 (fire all 20 in parallel)

    Read(file_path="/path/to/.claude/brain_snapshot.md", offset=13000, limit=650)
    ...

The script writes the absolute path to brain_snapshot.md into the Read calls,
so the instruction file is always correct for your local checkout.
